scripts.dev:de: LOCALE=de pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=de vitepress dev
scripts.dev:sr: LOCALE=sr pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=sr vitepress dev
scripts.dev:it: LOCALE=it pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=it vitepress dev
scripts.dev:pt_BR: LOCALE=pt_BR pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=pt_BR vitepress dev
scripts.i18n: .gitlab/update_po4a_conf.sh && po4a --verbose .po4a.conf && perl -pi -e 's/^\"POT-Creation-Date: .*/\"POT-Creation-Date: \\n\"/' i18n/zammad-org.pot && pnpm run build-language-config-json-files && pnpm run reset-po-changes
scripts.build: pnpm build:en && pnpm build:de && pnpm build:sr && pnpm build:it && pnpm build:pt_BR
scripts.build:de: LOCALE=de pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=de NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" vitepress build
scripts.build:sr: LOCALE=sr pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=sr NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" vitepress build
scripts.build:it: LOCALE=it pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=it NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" vitepress build
scripts.build:pt_BR: LOCALE=pt_BR pnpm i18n:locale && BUILD_LOCALE=pt_BR NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" vitepress build
scripts.build-language-config-json-files: (cd .vitepress; for FILE in *.yaml; do npx yaml < $FILE --json --single > $FILE.json; done)
scripts.reset-po-changes: echo 'Only weblate may update .po files, reverting any changes.' && git restore i18n/*.po
